description: Free: sets the Nostr key (npub) that gets direct-message reminders 14, 7 and 1 days before the hostname expires, when grace starts and before removal, or removes it with clear=true. The key gets reminders only, no control. A hostname owned by an account keeps its reminders at the account (account_reminders). Pass the hostname token (jdh_...) from the create answer, or a scoped account API key (jdk_...) made in the dashboard. Either passes through your model context and transcript: treat it like a password.

api_key.description: Instead of token: an account API key (jdk_...) whose scope covers this object (read, or write for changes).

clear.description: true removes the reminder key instead (give no npub then).

npub.description: The Nostr public key (npub1... or 64 hex) that gets direct-message reminders before the hostname expires. Reminders only: it gets no control.

token.description: The hostname token (jdh_...); or give api_key.

name: hostname_reminders
title: Expiry reminders for a dynamic hostname by Nostr DM (free, token)
